programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.a_level_offer: AAA including Mathematics (where an A-level Science subject is taken, a pass in the practical science element is also required)
programs.ib_offer: 18 points at Higher level to include 5 in HL Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or 6 in HL Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
programs.ap_offer: No course-specific AP grades are published. US route (general, for a course asking for AAA): High School Diploma with 3.0 GPA, two Honors classes at A, plus one AP at 5 (or one IB HL course at 6, or one Dual Enrolment course at A). Any subject-specific requirement of the course (here Mathematics) must be met with an AP, or an IB HL course; the page does not name which Calculus AP. If you have not taken two Honors classes, one AP can replace one Honors class (e.g. three APs). Applicants living outside the US: a minimum of three AP subjects with grades of 4 or 5, with subject-specific requirements applying.
programs.required_subjects: A-level Mathematics; GCSE English Language grade 4 (C) or equivalent; IB: HL Mathematics (5 for Analysis and Approaches, 6 for Applications and Interpretation)
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 80 overall with no less than 18 in reading, 17 in listening, 20 in speaking and 19 in writing. Tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4 overall with no less than 4 in each component. Single test taken in a test centre; MyBest scores and Paper Edition not accepted.
programs.english_note: Leeds undergraduate degrees: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in each component; PTE Academic 60 overall with no less than 59 in each component.
programs.notes: Typical offer for September 2027 entry; Access to Leeds contextual offer ABB including A in Mathematics. The course page gives no date: it says to check the UCAS deadline (UCAS equal-consideration date 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK time, https://www.ucas.com/applying/applying-to-university/dates-and-deadlines-for-uni-applications ); Leeds may consider later applications. The page prints no IB points total, only 18 points at Higher level. AP route: https://www.leeds.ac.uk/dir-record/profiles/21950/united-states-of-america . English requirements: https://www.leeds.ac.uk/international-applying/doc/entry-requirements

programs.name: Economics BSc
programs.a_level_offer: AAA (GCSE Mathematics grade A/7 and English Language grade B/5 or equivalent also required; no A-level Mathematics requirement is printed)
programs.ib_offer: 35 points overall with 17 points from Higher Level subjects, plus Mathematics via a 5 at Standard Level or a 4 at Higher Level, and English Language via a 5 at SL or HL English A, or a 7 at SL English B, or a 6 at HL English B
programs.ap_offer: No course-specific AP grades are published. US route (Leeds University Business School, for degrees requiring AAA or AAB at A-level, US-domiciled applicants): High School Graduation Diploma with a minimum GPA of 3.0, and at least one externally assessed qualification (AP or Dual Enrolment/College course), plus two more qualifications from any combination of AP, Honors class or Dual Enrolment/College course. Mathematics may be met by ACT Maths 28, SAT Maths 670, AP Calculus AB or BC at grade 3, or Grade 12 Pre-Calculus/Calculus (GPA 4.0 / 90% for GCSE A/7). English may be met by ACT English 28, SAT Evidence-based Reading/Writing 700, AP English Language or Literature at grade 3, or Grade 12 English with GPA 3.0. Applicants taking US qualifications in other countries: a minimum of three AP subjects at 555 for AAA degrees (excluding AP Seminar and AP Research).
programs.required_subjects: GCSE Mathematics grade A/7 and English Language grade B/5 (or equivalents, see AP and IB routes)
programs.toefl_note: Leeds University Business School undergraduate: TOEFL iBT 4.5 overall with no less than 4 in each component (new 1-6 scale; the page does not give an old 0-120 figure).
programs.english_note: Leeds University Business School undergraduate: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no less than 6 in each component; PTE Academic 64 overall with no less than 60 in each component; Cambridge B2 First 176 overall with no less than 169 in any component.
programs.notes: Typical offer for September 2027 entry; Access to Leeds contextual offer ABB. The course page states: the deadline for international students to apply to Leeds University Business School courses is 30 June (no year is printed, so 30 June 2027 is assumed). The UCAS equal-consideration date is 13 Jan 2027 18:00 UK time (https://www.ucas.com/applying/applying-to-university/dates-and-deadlines-for-uni-applications ), and Leeds recommends international applicants apply as early as possible. The Business School entry-requirements page lists AAA in any subject. AP route: https://business.leeds.ac.uk/dir-record/lubs-qualifications/558/united-states-of-america-usa . English: https://business.leeds.ac.uk/undergraduate/doc/entry-requirements

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng
programs.a_level_offer: A*AA including Mathematics and either Physics or Chemistry (a pass in the practical science element is also required)
programs.ib_offer: 18 points at higher level to include 6 points in higher level Mathematics and Physics or Chemistry
programs.ap_offer: No course-specific AP grades are published. US route (general, for a course asking A*AA): High School Diploma with 3.0 GPA, two Honors classes at A+ and A, plus one AP at 5 (or one IB HL course at 6, or one Dual Enrolment course at A). Subject-specific requirements of the course (here Mathematics and Physics or Chemistry) must be met with an AP, or an IB HL course; the page does not name which AP exams. If you have not taken two Honors classes, one AP can replace one Honors class. Applicants living outside the US: a minimum of three AP subjects with grades of 4 or 5, with subject-specific requirements applying.
programs.required_subjects: A-level Mathematics and Physics or Chemistry; GCSE English Language grade 4 (C) or equivalent; IB: HL Mathematics (6) and HL Physics or Chemistry
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 80 overall with no less than 18 in reading, 17 in listening, 20 in speaking and 19 in writing. Tests taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4 overall with no less than 4 in each component. Single test taken in a test centre; MyBest scores and Paper Edition not accepted.
programs.english_note: Leeds undergraduate degrees: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in each component; PTE Academic 60 overall with no less than 59 in each component.
programs.notes: Typical offer for September 2027 entry; Access to Leeds contextual offer AAB including Mathematics and Physics or Chemistry.
